_summary: Palette: the kit's cool neutrals and near-white ladder in light, its chrome washes over #171717 in dark; Figma blue replaced by the kit's indigo for selection, focus and primary fills
Shape: the kit's radius ladder with squircle corners; 14px text buttons, 16/6/10 concentric menus, 18px dialogs; circles and pills opt out to true round
Density kept (12px text, 24px rows); spacing snapped to the kit's 4px grid, no 10/14/18px steps; one 12px caption size replaces 11px
Interaction: zero-delay inverse tooltips, instant menus with 150ms exits, dialogs scale 0.96→1, 2% press, hover only on fine pointers, indigo focus edge + halo on keyboard only
Icons: 24 kit glyphs, one flat 2-unit stroke, six size roles (12–24); copy tightened to the kit's content rules

overview.title: Editor overview
changes: Selected tool and selection handles move from Figma blue to kit indigo
Panels sit on the kit's white / #171717 card ground with cool neutral controls
Selected layer row is an indigo tint, not a grey
Fields are filled wells with an 8px squircle corner

inspector-design.title: Inspector: Design tab
changes: Fields, selects and pads share one filled well with an 8px squircle
Chosen segment is a darker fill: no white chip, no shadow, no outline
Icon buttons wear full ink; 'on' is an indigo tint
Section captions use the 12px caption role instead of 11px
Keyboard focus: indigo edge + 3px halo; mouse clicks draw no ring

inspector-changes.title: Inspector: Changes tab
changes: Note rows are 16px kit cards, concentric with their 8px mini buttons
Row actions also show on keyboard focus and on touch
Switches and fields take the kit focus ring and 2% press
Delete hovers to a red wash, not a solid red block

code.title: Code tab
changes: Syntax colors come from the kit's decorative hues (blue, violet, green, coral)
Code sits on the kit control surface with relaxed code leading

left-controls.title: Left panel: Controls tab
changes: Tab pill is the kit's selected-tab fill and slides in 150ms
Rows and fields follow the inspector's well, corner and focus treatment

design-system.title: Inspector: Design system tab
changes: Info mark in full ink; hovers only with a real pointer
Empty and loading states use the kit's reading leading and loaded geometry

toolbar.title: Toolbar with tooltip
changes: Selected tool is an indigo fill; other icons wear full ink at rest
Tooltip appears instantly as an inverse ink chip (12px, 6×12 padding)
Moving along the bar slides the tooltip; closing fades in 150ms
Bar uses the kit's floating elevation: wide soft cast, 1px hairline, dark rim light

layer-menu.title: Layer context menu
changes: Kit menu geometry: 16px corner, 6px padding, 10px concentric rows
Opens instantly in place; neutral highlight on the hovered row

toasts.title: Toasts
changes: Floating card: 16px corner, overlay shadow and hairline
Scales into place instead of sliding up; exits in 150ms
Close ✕ in full ink; Undo uses the shared 14px button

annotation-composer.title: Annotation composer
changes: Composer card at 22px, concentric with its 14px buttons
Opens with no entrance travel; 150ms exit
Primary button is kit indigo

saved-styles.title: Saved styles panel
changes: Selected style is a fill with no outline
Rename and delete wear full ink; delete hovers to a red wash
Filter and value fields share one corner, well and focus edge
Type eyebrows use 10px caps with the kit's 0.08em tracking

token-picker.title: Token picker
changes: Opens instantly as a 16px card with one hairline (was two)
Rows are 10px highlights inset 6px, concentric with the card
Closed field is a filled well that stays lit while its list is open

app-chooser.title: App chooser
changes: Menu opens instantly and fades out in 150ms
16px card, 6px padding, 10px rows, concentric
Current app is an indigo fill instead of a side stripe
One hairline instead of a double border

start-screen.title: Start screen
changes: Kit field (filled, 16px corner) and 14px buttons with a 2% press
Squircle corners and kit type sizes; dark only

shortcut-sheet.title: Keyboard shortcut sheet
changes: A kit dialog: 18px corner, 70% static scrim
Scales in from 96% instead of drifting down
Close button sits concentric in the corner (10px)
Title uses the kit heading weight 650

libraries.title: Design system tab: library added
changes: Library cards are kit cards: 16px corner, hairline edge, no shadow
Buttons in the file drawer readable in light

library-signin.title: Library sign-in dialog
changes: Kit dialog: 18px corner, 24px inset, modal elevation, static scrim
Scales in from 96%, out to 98%
Secondary buttons readable in light; heading at weight 650

lint.title: Audit findings and canvas markers
changes: Findings keep hue + shape: red errors, amber warnings in the kit's status-text colors
Badges hover on the shared 150ms timing, only on fine pointers
Keyboard focus draws the kit ring on every row

layers-states.title: Layers: hover and selection
changes: Selected row is an indigo tint (kit 'unseen' hue), not a grey
Names in full ink, no wrapping
Row actions reveal on hover, keyboard focus or touch, and can't be clicked while hidden
Filter is a filled field; its border only appears on focus
